Frozen shoulder causes pain, stiffness and restricted movement of the shoulder joint. Everyday activities such as combing your hair, wearing clothes, reaching behind your back or lifting your arm can become challenging.
In this video, Hansaji explains how gentle exercises, suitable yoga asanas and simple daily habits can help manage frozen shoulder and gradually improve shoulder mobility.
Five exercises for frozen shoulder covered in this video:
1. Gentle Shoulder Rolls – Help release muscular tension and prepare the shoulder for movement.
